title: etcd3gw client HTTP error handling
locator: Etcd3Client.post maps 500/503/408/504/412 to selected exception classes; other non-200 responses raise generic Etcd3Exception(resp.text, resp.reason).
notes: Supports the adapter compatibility layer: structured error body may be present in Etcd3Exception arguments even though the HTTP status is not retained as a dedicated field. Current runtime dependency pin is etcd3gw 2.7.0.
